title: Identify the Coefficients
text:
For $y = x^2 - 6x + 5$, comparing with $y = ax^2 + bx + c$:

$a = 1$, $b = -6$, $c = 5$

title: Apply the Formula
text:
The axis of symmetry (and x-coordinate of turning point) is:

$x = -\frac{b}{2a} = -\frac{-6}{2(1)} = \frac{6}{2}$

title: Calculate the x-coordinate
text:
$x = \frac{6}{2} = 3$

The axis of symmetry is the vertical line $x = 3$.
